content.title: Singapore Residents Can Expect Self-Driving Shuttles From Grab And WeRide Soon
content.summary: WeRide (NASDAQ:WRD) has announced the deployment of its autonomous vehicles in Singapore as part of Grab Holdings’ (NASDAQ:GRAB) first self-driving shuttle service. The new service, dubbed Ai.R (Autonomously Intelligent Ride), is a collaboration with Grab, a leading super app in Southeast Asia. Selected by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) as the exclusive service to operate on two designated routes in the Punggol neighborhood, Ai.R will launch with a fleet of 11 vehicles.
